Privacy Policy

Last updated: September 17, 2026

Eric's Designs provides digital design, marketing, development, automation and client-management services. This policy explains how we handle information submitted through our website, Meta lead forms and the Eric's Designs CRM.

Information we collect

We may collect your name, business name, email address, phone number, service requirements, project details and any other information you choose to submit through a contact or lead form.

How we use information

We use this information to respond to enquiries, prepare quotations, provide requested services, manage client relationships and improve our services. Lead information from Meta forms is securely imported into our CRM for these purposes.

Sharing and security

We do not sell personal information. We only share information with service providers where needed to operate our business or meet legal obligations. We use reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect information.

Retention and your choices

We retain information only as long as needed for the purposes described above or as required by law. You may request access, correction or deletion of your information by contacting us.
